preview.downloadLink: Download the invoice as a PDF

rounding.title: Rounding
rounding.hint: Rounding applies per project, task and day, never per entry.

clients.title: Clients
clients.lead: Clients with address and invoice details. Projects and rates are on each client's page.
clients.archiveText: The client leaves the list and cannot be restored here. Projects, booked time and rates are kept.
clients.openDraft: This client still has an invoice draft. Issue or discard the draft first.
clients.deleteText: A client without projects and rates is deleted for good. If projects or rates still refer to it, it stays in the records as locked, a restriction of processing under Art. 18 DSGVO (GDPR). You may have to confirm your sign-in again first.

firstRun.title: No clients yet
firstRun.text: Project time is always booked on a project, and every project belongs to a client.

client.restrictedText: Locked under Art. 18 DSGVO (GDPR): the details stay in the records, the client can no longer be chosen anywhere.
client.name: Name
client.countryHint: Two-letter country code, such as DE, AT or NL
client.buyerReferenceHint: Public-sector clients need a Leitweg-ID, the invoice then goes out as XRechnung. Otherwise, for example, the client's order number.
client.paymentTermsHint: In days. Leave empty for the general default.

projects.title: Projects
projects.name: Project
projects.budgetHint: Hours, such as 40 or 37:30. Leave empty for no budget. A warning shows from 80%.
projects.empty: No projects for this client yet
projects.emptyHint: Time can only be booked once the client has a project.
projects.allArchived: All projects of this client are archived.

members.title: Who books on the project
members.openHint: Everyone with a personnel record can book on the project.
members.closedHint: Only the members and HR can book on the project.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: Split up the project. Without a setting of its own, a task takes over whether the project is billable.
tasks.name: Task
tasks.archiveText: The task can no longer be chosen and cannot be restored here. Booked time and rates are kept.
tasks.empty: No tasks. Time is booked on the project itself.

rates.title: Rates

lead.default: Applies when no more specific rate fits the client, project, task or person.
lead.client: Apply to all projects of this client unless the project or task has a rate of its own.
lead.project: The most specific rate applies: task before project before client, a rate for one person before the one for everyone.

rates.formHint: A rate is never changed, a new one with a later valid-from date takes over. It applies to all unbilled time from that day on.
rates.amountHint: Net per hour, such as 95 or 95.50
rates.deleteText: The rate has not taken effect yet. Without it, the previous rate stays in force from that day on.

empty.client: No rate of its own, the default rate applies.
empty.project: No rate of its own, the client's rate or the default rate applies.

invoicesList.title: Invoices
invoicesList.lead: Drafts, issued, paid and cancelled invoices.

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.text: An invoice is built from a client's unbilled time.

newInvoice.title: New invoice
newInvoice.lead: Choose a client and a period. Unbilled time is bundled into line items.
newInvoice.nothingUnbilled: No unbilled time for this client.
newInvoice.nothingToBill: There is no billable time with a rate on file in this period.

reports.title: Time report
reports.lead: A client's project time as PDF or CSV, at most 366 days.
reports.rangeUnordered: The end lies before the start

settings.title: Invoicing profile
settings.lead: Address, tax details and defaults for every invoice.
settings.sandboxHint: In the demo only the tax profile and the previous year's revenue can be changed, the other details stay fixed.
settings.sandboxRefused: Cannot be changed in the demo: {{fields}}. Only the tax profile and the previous year's revenue can be changed here.
settings.contactHint: Required for XRechnung. Appears on the invoice as the contact for questions.
settings.previousYearRevenueHint: Net, in €, for the § 19 UStG thresholds

smallBusiness.ok: Previous year's revenue was {{previous}}, this year {{issued}} issued so far and {{draft}} in drafts. Within the § 19 UStG thresholds.
smallBusiness.previous_year_exceeded: Last year's revenue of {{previous}} was above €25,000. The small business rule no longer applies this year.
smallBusiness.crosses_current_limit: With {{issued}} issued and {{draft}} in drafts, current revenue is approaching the €100,000 threshold.

settings.ibanHint: Changing the IBAN asks for your sign-in to be confirmed again.
settings.invoicePrefixHint: Goes before the running number, such as RE or INV

invoiceEditor.draftLead: Draft. Line items and period can still be changed.
invoiceEditor.noLines: No line items for this period yet.
invoiceEditor.quantityInvalid: Quantity greater than 0 and up to 999,999.999, with up to three decimal places
invoiceEditor.unitPriceHint: Net per unit, such as 95 or 95.50
invoiceEditor.unitPriceInvalid: Amount up to ±€9,999,999.99, with up to two decimal places
invoiceEditor.exemptionReasonHint: With the legal reference, for example § 4 Nr. 21 UStG

hints.service_deadline_14a_1: For this service, the invoice must be issued by the 15th day of the following month (§ 14a (1) UStG).
hints.public_buyer_wants_xrechnung: The client has a Leitweg-ID, but the invoice is set up as a PDF. Public-sector clients expect an XRechnung, the format can be chosen when issuing.
hints.long_timer_entry: A timer entry on this invoice ran for 12 hours or more. Issuing asks you to confirm the time. If it is wrong, discard the draft, correct the entry and create the draft again.

blockers.vat_id_missing: The invoicing party's own details are missing a VAT ID.
blockers.tax_number_missing: The invoicing party's own details are missing a tax number.
blockers.text_not_xml: A text on the invoice contains control characters an e-invoice does not allow. Check the line item texts, the client's details and the settings.
blockers.seller_address_incomplete: The settings are missing the invoicing party's street, postcode or city. Without them no invoice can be issued, in any format.
blockers.seller_tax_id_missing: For an e-invoice, the settings are missing the invoicing party's tax number or VAT ID. For services to a non-EU country outside the scope of VAT, it has to be the tax number.
blockers.exemption_reason_missing: For an e-invoice, the tax-exempt line items are missing the reason for the exemption.
blockers.seller_contact_missing: For XRechnung, the settings are missing the contact person's name, phone or email.
blockers.iban_missing: For XRechnung, the settings are missing the IBAN.
blockers.buyer_reference_missing: For XRechnung, the client is missing a buyer reference, the Leitweg-ID for public bodies.
blockers.buyer_endpoint_missing: For XRechnung, the client is missing an email address or a Leitweg-ID as electronic address.
blockers.buyer_address_incomplete: The client is missing a street, postcode or city. Only an invoice up to €250 gross can do without the address, never as XRechnung.
blockers.tax_profile_mismatch: The invoice's tax profile differs from the current one in the settings. Discard the draft and create it again.
blockers.tax_category_mismatch: A line item has a tax category that does not fit this invoice. Edit an added line item; for line items from booked time, discard the draft and create it again.
blockers.tax_rate_mismatch: The tax rate of a line item differs from the rate in force. Save an added line item again; for line items from booked time, discard the draft and create it again.
blockers.total_negative: The invoice total is negative. Check the line items, an invoice with a negative total cannot be issued.
blockers.total_too_large: The invoice total is too large to issue. Check the quantities and unit prices of the line items.
blockers.long_timer_entry: A timer entry ran for 12 hours or more. Confirm that the time is right, or discard the draft and correct the entry.

invoiceEditor.issueWarning: The invoice now gets a number and can no longer be changed afterwards.
invoiceEditor.longTimersChecked: Timer entries of 12 hours or more checked, the time is right
invoiceEditor.discardText: The draft is deleted, the underlying time is then available again for another invoice.

invoiceView.xrechnungHint: Issued as XRechnung: the XML file is the invoice, the PDF is only a copy for reading.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel invoice {{number}}
cancelDialog.body: This creates a cancellation invoice with its own number that refers to this invoice and fully reverses it. This cannot be undone afterwards.
cancelDialog.reasonHint: At least 10 characters, appears in the audit log.
